blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — In-person classes were cancelled in Albay on Friday (Nov. 6) due to the expected extreme heat and scheduled power interruption. Bicol Region READ: Walang Pasok: High heat index prompts class suspensions on Nov. 3 The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration earlier reported that the heat index in Coron, Palawan, Dumangas, Iloilo, and Dipolog, Zamboanga del Norte may reach up to 43 degrees Celsius. Meanwhile, areas in Iloilo City, IloIlo and Zamboanga City, Zamboanga del Sur may experience high temperatures of up to 42 degrees Celsius.
